project_name: House Of The Knight - Revamp Design Guidelines
design_archetype: Bright Editorial Luxury with Cinematic Depth (Bucks Sauce Inspired)
overall_mood: Bright Editorial Luxury — white/cream primary canvas with high-contrast obsidian editorial blocks, dramatic lighting overlays, subtle noise texture, bold kinetic serif typography, and gold/bronze metallic accents.

forbidden_colors: flat pure gray without warm tint

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl uppercase tracking-wider leading-[1.05]

scale.overline: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400

hero_revamp_blueprint.concept: Replaces the cheap 3D bottle with a high-impact, cinematic multi-fragrance stage featuring real bottle photography, dynamic dramatic background lighting effects, parallax motion, and interactive scent switcher.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise overlay using SVG pattern or CSS pseudo-element fixed over background with 0.03 opacity
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-amber-900/10 dark:border-amber-500/15 with inner shadow or subtle ambient drop shadow
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/75 border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10
visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow drifting oversized outline typography with low opacity in editorial separator sections

home_page.header: Sticky glassmorphism header with logo, nav links (Collection, Atelier, Notes), dark/light toggle, account button, cart count drawer button
home_page.hero: Cinematic real photography hero stage with animated line reveals, scent switcher bar, price badge in ₹, and parallax float effect
home_page.manifesto: High-contrast dark editorial block with kinetic marquee text and royal brand statement
home_page.collection: Asymmetric Bento Grid showcasing all 4 perfumes with note pills, quick-add-to-cart buttons, and hover tilt effects
home_page.notes_atlas: Interactive fragrance pyramid section (Top, Heart, Base) with tabbed note exploration
home_page.atelier: Craftsmanship storytelling section with rich image grid and gilded accent callouts
home_page.footer: Deep dark obsidian footer with luxury newsletter signup, brand mark, navigation, and copyright

instructions_to_main_agent.rule_1: Replace BottleScene low-poly canvas with cinematic photo hero BottleScene.js component that renders high-definition photo stage with animated glowing pedestal, atmospheric particle movement, and bottle switcher.
instructions_to_main_agent.rule_2: Ensure every interactive button, input, and link has `data-testid` attribute for robust automated testing.
instructions_to_main_agent.rule_3: Keep pricing strictly in Indian Rupee (₹) matching database records.
instructions_to_main_agent.rule_4: Do not break existing backend integration or cart context; enhance visual presentation while preserving all API calls and flow logic.
instructions_to_main_agent.rule_5: Avoid generic Vercel/Inter styling — enforce serif headers, elevated warm luxury palette, and micro-interactions on hover.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, tabs, cards) MUST contain data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.contrast: Ensure WCAG AA compliance for normal and large text on all backgrounds.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.responsive: Mobile-first grid system (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4) with generous spacing (p-6 to p-12).
